note: Blind held-out set 3 (Phase 5 leftover). Written and labelled without seeing the extractor. Measured once.

items.text: Do you think I should accept Anna's offer to go sailing?
Can Mara and I still meet on Friday?
Could you help me word a note to Tom about the rent?
Would visiting Porto with Jonas be a bad idea right now?
Lea's birthday is next week, what should I get her?
Should I call my sister Ruth before I fly to Lisbon?
Tell me something funny to send to Omar.
Can you remind me what Priya said about the Lake Como trip?
Do you think Dan would like a trip to Kyoto?
Should I ask Bea to move in with me in Berlin?
What's a good way to tell Sam I can't come to Glasgow?
Could you draft a message to Hana about moving our call?
Is it worth taking the night train from Rome to see Marco?
Any advice on helping my brother Eli with his job search in Madrid?
Should I tell Nina what happened in Hamburg last year?
Where should Kai and I go for dinner in Brooklyn?
Can you help me plan a surprise party for Rosie?
How do I politely decline Jae's invitation to Seoul?
Would Milo enjoy the Edinburgh festival?
Is it fair that Ivy keeps cancelling on the Yosemite plan?
Had a lovely lunch with Jonas in Porto today.
Feeling a bit tired after the long shift.
Any idea how to stay focused?
Dana finally got the job in Austin, I'm so proud of her.
I miss the summers we spent at the lake house.
Stuck in traffic again, so frustrating.
Just finished reading a good book by the window.
My sister called me from Leeds this morning.
Thanks a lot, Rafa, you really saved my day.
The weather here in Oslo is grey and quiet.
I've been feeling anxious about the exam tomorrow.
Watched Amelie again last night, still love it.
Been listening to Yesterday on repeat all week.
Got the keys to the new flat, so relieved.
I'm so lonely in this city since Mara moved to Dublin.
Cooked a big pot of soup for the neighbours.
Our team won the match, I feel so much pride.
Ravi's old radio still plays in the kitchen.
The sea in Naples looked calm this morning.
Feeling grateful for all the support from Eva this week.
